records.name: The council: a hall cut from the rock in its pit
records.note: after Kailasa, cut down into the ground: a pit 12 m deep down a sunken lane; the council hall left standing (the pillared chamber, a tiered tower on its roof), the pavilion, bridges of rock, two lamp pillars, cloisters

records.name: Provisioner (constructed)
records.note: tuff block under a flat roof, an awning over the front; the selling room at the street door, the kitchen beside it

records.name: General goods (constructed)
records.note: tuff block under a flat roof, an awning over the front; the selling room at the street door, the store beside it

records.name: Lampwright (constructed)
records.note: tuff block under a flat roof, an awning over the front; the selling room at the street door, the workroom beside it

records.name: Potter (constructed)
records.note: tuff block under a flat roof, an awning over the front; the selling room at the street door, the workroom beside it

records.name: The muster ground
records.note: a levelled floor, a dais, weapon racks, the standard

records.name: The park under the light well
records.note: a round garden under the light well: a lawn, paths along the lanes, a pool and fountain in the daylight, trees, shrubs, flower beds, giant alecaps at the shaded rim, benches

records.name: Kiva
records.note: sunk 3.6 m under an earth roof: down the ladder through the hatch; the bench terrace, the altar under the murals, the hearth, deflector, ventilator and sipapu, the great incense burner where Ranj is burned

records.name: The temple: cut from one rock
records.note: a gateway into a pit cut from the top of the rock; the podium left standing with its stair, the sanctum under a pierced lattice dome lit from inside, four shrines, two lamp pillars, cloisters in the pit's walls

records.name: The capital's barracks (carved)
records.note: its door in the hall's wall: the guardroom, the pillared dormitory hall, the armoury and the mess off it

records.name: Carved estate: the columned hall
records.note: a pillared reception hall behind a front of engaged columns, a court under its own light shaft, the family's and the service corridors: 13 rooms

records.name: Carved estate: the loggia
records.note: two storeys: a domed hall; upstairs a loggia behind five arches between the family's rooms; down a flight a court under a light shaft, the service rooms: 12 rooms

records.name: Brewery (carved)
records.note: the taproom at the face, the brewing hall behind it (mash tuns, fermenting crocks), the cooperage off it, the cool cellar 2.6 m down a flight

records.name: Fungal alchemist (carved)
records.note: the selling room at the face, the domed still room behind it, the glow-culture room off its side, the dark spawn room deepest

records.name: Weaponsmith (carved front)
records.note: the selling room behind a counter in the shopfront, the smithy behind it, its smoke shaft to the top of the rock

records.name: Knapper and mirror-maker (carved front)
records.note: the selling room behind a counter in the shopfront, the workroom behind it

records.name: Hot-spring bath
records.note: the changing room behind the door; the domed bath hall behind it round its steaming pool (the Throne's heat)

records.name: Bat roost
records.note: a cave mouth, a passage down a metre to a domed chamber where the guano is gathered for the alecap beds

records.name: Rolling stone door
records.note: a passage through the rock, the round stone door rolled into its side slot (closed on a schedule), its lever

records.name: The cistern hall: a stepwell under the rock
records.note: a vaulted hall 9 m deep: terraces of rock step down on three sides to the still water, pillars rise from the water to the vault, a causeway runs out to a platform where water is drawn

records.name: Funeral catacombs
records.note: down 4.5 m to the mortuary chapel; loculi corridors lined with bones to an ossuary chamber at each end; the Keeper's cell

records.name: Yam terraces
records.note: three terraces of yam vines on a light well's floor or a clearing: retaining walls, a stair, an irrigation channel

records.name: Vegetable plots
records.note: three terraces of beans, gourds and greens in rows; retaining walls, a stair, an irrigation channel

records.name: Gallery of cells: the spine
records.note: a corridor descending in three levels with twelve cells, a hearth hall, a kiva, a cistern and an air shaft

records.name: The stores: a side tunnel walled off
records.note: a side tunnel 5 m wide walled off at its mouth (the wall and its door are the building); four store rooms cut off it

records.name: Alecap beds in the dark
records.note: a long low hall cut in the dark: eight compost and dung beds in stone kerbs either side of a water channel, spawn racks
